title: Brits are ‘rethinking’ what beauty purchases are worth their money, finds report
summary: New insights from Lloyds Bank’s The Lloyds Looks Ahead: The Worth it Economy report highlights how beauty and wellness purchases have cemented their position as an essential part of consumers’ budgets
